metrics.method: Full history re-read: 2026-08-07 to 2026-09-10 (152 lines, id 62 missing). Tail: paid 09-10 11:10, ChatDeleteUser 11:12:35, ChatAddUser 21:01:49 (bulk add, same second as in two other client chats), nothing since. 'Questions' = distinct client asks requiring a reply. 'Unanswered over 24h' = Aug 19 drop, voice-memo offer, posting cadence, invoicing cadence, wire friction, freeloader screenshots request, which IG the quota feeds, nude-preview breach, Drive-fix closure. max_team_silence_days = 2026-08-21 to 2026-08-27; plus a ~101-hour near-silence 09-04 to 09-08. what_client_wanted: Aggressive selling with a girlfriend tone and her content boundaries respected: 'don’t be afraid to be aggressive with selling or pricing, and always be like a gf to them' (2026-08-07); 'chat team is not allowed to send free full nude previews' (2026-09-04).

Mica's personal reframe on 2026-08-31 converted a refusal into a booked call in six minutes - one personal message did what 20 days of a self-serve link had not.

The three complaints she wrapped in emoji and hedges - wire friction (08-21), Instagram takedowns (08-28/31) and free nude previews (09-04) - were exactly the three we ignored, and the first became her resignation message.
